service_name.description: Human-readable name for the MUC service

service_jid.description: JID (Jabber ID) of the MUC service as seen by clients (e.g., muc.example.com)

listen_port.description: Port on which the MUC service listens for incoming connections

listen_interface.description: Network interface to bind to; use '127.0.0.1' to restrict to local connections

db_type.description: Database backend to use for persistent storage

db_path.description: File path for SQLite database (only used if db_type is 'sqlite')

db_host.description: Hostname or IP of PostgreSQL server (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_port.description: Port of PostgreSQL server (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_name.description: Database name for PostgreSQL (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_user.description: Database user for PostgreSQL (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

db_password.description: Password for PostgreSQL database user (only used if db_type is 'postgresql')

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for connections (recommended for production)

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format)

tls_key_file.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format)

log_file.description: Path to the log file (use '-' for stdout)

room_default_name.description: Default room name shown in discovery listings

room_default_history.description: Default number of historical messages sent to new occupants (or 'never', 'from_join', 'from_subscribe', 'integer')

max_rooms_per_user.description: Maximum number of MUC rooms a single user may create

max_history_messages.description: Upper bound on number of history messages that may be requested per room

allow_private_messages.description: Allow private messages between occupants of the same room

allow_visitor_nick_change.description: Allow visitors (non-privileged occupants) to change their nicknames

allow_user_invitation.description: Allow regular members to invite others to the room

allow_subscription.description: Allow users to subscribe to room presence notifications

max_occupants.description: Global maximum number of occupants allowed across all rooms

rooms.description: List of pre-provisioned rooms to create at startup

jid.description: Full JID of the room (e.g., room@example.com)

public.description: Whether the room is discoverable via service discovery

members_only.description: Only members may join the room

moderated.description: Only moderators and participants may speak

description.description: Short description of the room's purpose

owners.description: List of JIDs of room owners (full JIDs, e.g., admin@example.com)
